_meta.description: Needle productDetail 颗粒度扩展 — 定义每个字段的可检测性、提取方式、置信度阈值

schema_expansion.description: 当前 Hook Vision 的 needleSpec 只有 gauge/count/type/taper 4 个字段。目标是扩展到 7+ 字段，覆盖 cartridge 级别视觉信息。

needle_type.method: tip arrangement analysis — circle tight=RL, circle loose=RS, double row=M1, curved=CM, single=F

needle_type_name.method: derived from needle_type using NEEDLE_TYPE_NAMES mapping

needle_gauge.method: read from printed label on cartridge body or packaging text

needle_count.detectability: medium — can count tips in macro, approximate in medium shots
needle_count.method: count visible needle tips at cartridge opening

needle_taper.detectability: low — rarely visible in product shots
needle_taper.method: side profile of needle tip required to estimate taper length

cartridgeColor.method: direct observation of housing shell color

membraneType.method: check cartridge base for visible membrane color and material

connectionType.detectability: low — need side profile of base
connectionType.method: examine cartridge base side profile for thread vs smooth vs bayonet

packagingFormat.method: direct observation of how cartridge is packaged

brandPrediction.detectability: medium — based on housing color + label style combo
brandPrediction.method: combine cartridgeColor + label style for brand inference

brandConfidence.method: high = color+label match unique brand; medium = color matches 2+ brands; low = ambiguous

flowChannelVisible.method: examine clearance between needle bundle and inner housing wall through transparent housing sidewall

internalTaperVisible.detectability: low — requires side profile of tip plus transparent housing
internalTaperVisible.method: examine internal taper/convergence profile at housing tip from side view

detection_confidence_thresholds.description: Confidence levels for each detection method — used to decide which path to trust

label_text_extraction.condition: text visible and legible on cartridge body or packaging
label_text_extraction.action: use exact match, parse gauge+count+type+taper from text

tip_visual_analysis.condition: needle tip visible in macro or close-up (needle fills >30% of frame or macro shot)
tip_visual_analysis.action: fill type from tip arrangement, count from tip counting, leave gauge/taper as unknown

housing_color_analysis.action: fill cartridgeColor, infer brand from color_brand_map if unique match

packaging_analysis.action: fill packagingFormat, use packaging labels for additional brand/model confirmation

membrane_and_connection.condition: cartridge base visible in angled/side view

no_needle_detail_visible.condition: needle in frame but no detail visible (e.g. needle in machine, wide shot)

productDetail_assembly.description: How to assemble the final productDetail string from the structured fields

tip_only.input: macro: tip shows 3 needles in tight circle

style_to_needle_recommendation_engine.description: Enhanced recommendation logic — not just mapping style to needle type, but considering what DETAIL LEVEL is appropriate for the detected content

logic.use_case: product photo with legible label — can recommend exact same spec

logic.condition: productCategory=needle AND needleSpec has type only (partial)
logic.use_case: macro photo showing tip arrangement but no label
logic.recommendation_scope: recommend the identified type in common gauges

logic.condition: productCategory=needle AND brandPrediction is set but needleSpec is null
logic.use_case: brand photo showing cartridge color but not tip detail
logic.recommendation_scope: recommend brand's most popular needle configurations

logic.condition: contentType=process_shot showing tattooing with visible needle
logic.use_case: tattooing video where cartridge tip briefly visible
logic.recommendation_scope: match visible needle characteristics to detected tattoo style

needle_knowledge_gaps.description: 什么是当前 research 已覆盖 vs 未覆盖的 — 参见 needle_knowledge_gaps.json 完整调研。品牌情报/趋势/推理规则参见 needle_intelligence.json。
covered: 品牌视觉特征 (housing color, membrane, connection)
品质维度 (锋利度/回弹性/一致性等)
流道视觉识别 (inner diameter clearance + internal taper angle)
膜类型与流道关联 (membrane ↔ flow resistance relationship)
Needle ↔ Machine 兼容性矩阵 (connectionType 映射通用/专用品牌列表)
灭菌包装视觉识别 (Gamma dot vs EO Tyvek 区分方法)
品牌 taper 长度差异 (各品牌 ST/MT/LT/XLT 的 mm 定义不同)
品牌颜色标记系统 (Eikon/Precision/Cheyenne 的颜色编码规则)
价格区间与包装视觉关系 (budget/mid/premium 包装特征)
not_covered_yet: 染色/标记针尖 (needle tip coating) — 照片中不可见，跳过
Cartridge 外壳材料触感差异 (医疗级 vs 普通塑料) — 视觉无法判断，跳过
品牌型号映射 (1003RL → 品牌 SKU) — 行业通用编号已够用，跳过
